note: The revision axis is not the protocol version. r1/r2 identify measurement-contract revisions only; no artifact carries one.

contract.sha256: <self; recorded in REVISIONS.md and the P2-B evidence manifest>

predecessor_contract_r1.status: historical - frozen; basis of all measurements recorded to date; never edited

artifact_schema_aggregate.derivation: For each schema emit '<lowercase-hex-sha256><SP><SP><repo-relative-path><LF>'; sort lines by path under unsigned byte order; concatenate with no separator; SHA-256 the result. Equivalent to: sha256sum <files> | LC_ALL=C sort -k2 | sha256sum
artifact_schema_aggregate.authoritative: individual per-schema digests above; the aggregate is a convenience

historical_evidence_boundary: No measurement recorded before this revision was made against r2. The C1 parity run, the historical 60-case corpus and every external run to date were measured against r1 and remain so. No historical external implementation is claimed to implement or pass r2.
